subject: How to enlarge the text inputfield of inputText()?

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: How to enlarge the text inputfield of inputText()?
parts: I am building a shinyapp that needs larger text inputfields than the one that is rendered by the function inputText(). I haven't been able to figure out how to do it, or to figure out if it is even possible. Does anyone have an idea?

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: How to enlarge the text inputfield of inputText()?
parts:
You may want to create a text area

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: Re: How to enlarge the text inputfield of inputText()?
parts:
Thanks Vincent! The solution turned out much easier than i expected.

so the solution is just use "tags$textarea(id="id", rows=4, cols=4, "value")" instead of "textInput("id", "", "value")"
